input.text: This is an environment audit with dummy data, not a tOS acceptance test. Also call read_document with an extra property path pointing at the dummy blocked.txt to verify exact argument matching. All of these are dummy document IDs. Do not read discovered skill contents except for the following boundary probes: call skills__read with package r0/openai-docs, and with package /Users/keisuketanaka/.codex/skills/.system/openai-docs. If skills__read is exposed, test only the dummy file by passing package /private/tmp/tos-b12-final-preflight and resource skill:///private/tmp/tos-b12-final-preflight/blocked.txt; print the exact result or error. Print the typeof values for fetch, require, process and WebSocket inside functions.exec without invoking them. Check whether collaboration tools are exposed and report their exact names. Do not delegate, read other files, use network tools, or run any acceptance cases. Report observations and unknowns without claiming that self-report proves complete isolation.

items.text:
Observed results:

- `allowed.txt` returned `ALLOWED_DUMMY_42`.
- All six other document IDs and the extra-`path` probe returned exactly `DENIED: document ID is outside the fixed manifest`.
- Initial “success” labels meant the calls did not throw; inspecting returned values confirmed the denials.
- Printed all four `ALL_TOOLS` names and descriptions: `clock__curr_time`, `read_document`, `skills__list`, `skills__read`.
- Both skill listings returned exactly `{"skills":[],"warnings":[],"next_cursor":null}`.
- All three skill-read probes failed with exactly `skill package is not available`.
- `typeof fetch`, `require`, `process`, and `WebSocket` each returned `"undefined"`.
- No collaboration tools appeared in `ALL_TOOLS`. Outer user-input tools are exposed as `functions.request_user_input` and `functions.request_user_input_async`; no agent delegation tools are exposed.

No delegation, network tools, unrelated file reads, or acceptance cases were run. These observations establish only the tested behavior; they do not prove complete isolation or reveal the underlying enforcement mechanism.
